rules.never_near_hole_contact: No valid step has XY error <=5mm, absolute tip height <=3mm and force >=5N.
rules.wrong_way_correction: At the last valid step, aim-guess error exceeds the zero-guess error by >0.25mm with a nonzero >0.25mm guess, OR the net commanded movement correction points radially outward by >1mm summed over valid near-hole steps.
rules.stuck_on_rim: At least20 of the last40 valid steps meet the near-hole contact rule and their insertion-depth range is <1mm.
rules.timeout: Final recorded learner-truncated flag is true and learner-terminated flag is false.
